kind: Previously inspected forward-evidence diagnostic, not a new blind model-selection experiment
comparisons: replay saved quote selection against original decision clock
recompute frozen model scores from stored features without fitting
causal current-database feature reconstruction using only candles before each signal close boundary; revisions remain a confounder
match signal-close and current-quote underlying anchors; quantify geometry not counterfactual profitability
verify frozen entry/exit quotes, causality, fees, net labels and exit reasons
compare first eligible executable and first eligible score-passing trial per family/direction/protocol/day, preserving unknown first outcomes
check exact same-contract signal and next-bar historical option coverage; no substitutes
match selected-model signal scores to reference ORB trials by provider/index/bar/contract; distinguish different collection clocks

policy.entry_eligibility: cash affordability and gross 25% premium-stop risk within 3% capital, before outcomes
policy.grouping: provider/index/model/protocol hash/family/direction; never combine slippage settings
policy.selection: first by observed_at,id before reading outcome; incomplete/open first stays unknown
policy.freshness: Two observed dates cannot establish robust generalisation regardless of row count
policy.acceptance: No deployment or model selection. Any feature/score/selection reproduction discrepancy requires diagnosis; exact reproduced geometry difference warrants protocol-alignment proposal only. Any positive paired result is descriptive until independent support.

forbidden: replace unknown outcomes with later winners
claim candle proxies or poll samples are broker fills
limitations: No historical bid/ask or intrabar quote path can be invented
Source candles may have been revised since decision; reconstruction mismatch alone does not prove live feature bug
Observed exit timestamps are samples; changing anchor can change earlier exit timing that endpoint evidence cannot reconstruct
Research one-lot observations are not the selected model9 portfolio
Historical research has been searched repeatedly; no new success claim
